objectives.summary: The project aims to develop WebFrames, a creative application for generating animated images using SVG and CSS, with a focus on accessibility for both graphic designers and developers. The initial public version is expected to be released in November, following a three-month development period, and regular milestones will be established to monitor progress.

innovation.summary: WebFrames introduces a new image format and two custom open-source software applications that enhance animation capabilities without the limitations of existing formats like GIF and APNG. It allows for the generation of animated files with bitmap and vector artwork, automating the process of image import and SVG export, while ensuring compatibility with current web technologies.
key_points: WebFrames does not have the quality limitations of GIF.
WebFrames does not have the browser limitations of APNG, MNG, WebP, or video.
WebFrames allows the generation of animated files containing bitmap and vector artwork with transparency.
WebFrames automates the process of importing images and exporting an SVG file with embedded CSS animations.
WebFrames can export an animation with or without image compression.
Animation performance will be improved in browsers such as Chrome and Firefox.
